Role Overview
The IT Manager, EP-CNV Commercial Solutions Technical Product Owner is the accountable technology leader for the end-to-end product lifecycle of a portfolio of EMEA commercial solutions supporting Electrophysiology and Cardio-Neurovascular commercial processes. The role owns product strategy, roadmap, delivery, operations, modernization and value realization, partnering closely with Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Finance, Sales, Customer Service and regional technology teams.
This technical manager role combines empowered product ownership, strong technical leadership and people leadership. It translates business and compliance needs into an executable roadmap and prioritized backlog, directs a cross-functional product squad, and ensures the commercial products for order to cash remains secure, resilient, scalable, supportable and aligned with the wider MedTech pricing, contracting, ERP, CRM, data and reporting landscape.
The role is central to scaling the commercial solutions across EMEA while reducing country-specific complexity, improving pricing governance and user experience, strengthening delivery discipline, and preparing the platform for future enterprise architecture and ERP changes.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy, Value & Roadmap
• Own the pricing and other commercial solutions product vision, strategy, value proposition, multi-year roadmap and measurable outcomes in alignment with EP-CNV EMEA commercial and pricing priorities.
• Act as the empowered technology decision-maker for product priorities, balancing business value, user needs, compliance, risk, technical feasibility, capacity and total cost of ownership.
• Define and track OKRs and KPIs covering adoption, approval cycle time, pricing governance, reliability, performance, data quality, user experience, delivery predictability and realized business value.
• Lead build, buy, partner and platform-alignment assessments, including the long-term positioning of solution within the broader MedTech pricing and contracting ecosystem.
• Maintain transparent investment, resource and lifecycle plans, with clear recommendations for modernization, consolidation, integration or retirement decisions.

PRICING SOLUTION Product Ownership & Commercial Process Enablement
• Own the end-to-end pricing solution capabilities supporting pricing request creation, review, approval, execution, auditability and downstream price implementation.
• Partner with business product owners and market stakeholders to standardize pricing archetypes, approval models, roles, controls and affiliate onboarding, limiting localization to justified business, legal or regulatory needs.
• Translate business processes and policy requirements into product requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, test scenarios and a prioritized backlog.
• Ensure the product supports appropriate pricing governance, including approval authority, audit trails, data visibility, role-based access, pricing controls, and evidence required for audit and compliance.
• Lead discovery and design for customer and buying-group hierarchies, product restrictions, pricing templates, country permissions, tender and contract workflows, and related commercial scenarios.
• Own the pricing solution rollout playbook, affiliate readiness criteria, release sequencing, adoption approach and reusable implementation assets for EMEA expansion and potentially globally.

Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
• Provide hands-on technical leadership for the pricing solution application, data model, integrations, infrastructure, security, performance, observability and support model.
• Guide the evolution of the current .NET and SQL Server solution toward a more resilient, modular, maintainable and scalable architecture using approved enterprise patterns.
• Own architecture alignment across inbound master and transactional data, customer and product data, ERP interfaces, Contract Manager outputs, identity and access management, and Power BI or enterprise data-platform reporting.
• Drive technical debt reduction, secure coding, source-control governance, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, secrets management, vulnerability remediation and compliant release practices.
• Establish performance baselines, capacity models, service levels, recovery objectives and proactive monitoring to support growth in users, countries, transaction volumes and integrations.
• Prepare the product for future ERP and commercial-platform changes, including transition dependencies, interface redesign and data migration decisions.

Agile Delivery, Quality & Operations
• Lead product discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, dependency management, demonstrations, release readiness and retrospectives using a disciplined agile product-management approach.
• Coordinate technical engineers, shared platforms and external delivery partners to deliver agreed outcomes within scope, budget, quality and timeline expectations.
• Ensure end-to-end traceability from business requirement through technical design, development, testing, approval and production release.
• Own the test strategy across unit, integration, system, regression, performance, security and user-acceptance testing, with clear evidence and business sign-off.
• Oversee production health, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, change control, access reviews, support handoffs, knowledge management and continuous service improvement.
• Ensure adherence to applicable SDLC, cybersecurity, privacy, records management, quality, regulatory and financial-control requirements.

People Leadership & Product Squad Effectiveness
• Lead, coach and develop product and engineering team members, setting clear goals, decision rights, delivery expectations and development plans.
• Build a sustainable multi-person product and support model that reduces key-person dependency and protects critical product knowledge.
• Create an inclusive, high-accountability culture focused on customer value, technical excellence, transparency, continuous learning and pragmatic delivery.
• Plan product capacity and skills across employees, contractors and partners; manage performance, succession, onboarding and knowledge transfer for critical roles.
• Remove delivery roadblocks, resolve cross-squad priorities and escalate material trade-offs with concise options and recommendations.

Stakeholder Partnership & Change Adoption
• Act as the primary technology product contact for pricing solution, building trusted partnerships with EMEA Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Finance, Sales, Customer Service, market leaders and regional/global technology teams.
• Communicate roadmap, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs and value outcomes in clear executive and business language.
• Champion user-centered design, practical process simplification, demonstrations, training, communications and adoption planning so delivered capabilities are embedded in day-to-day operations.
• Facilitate governance and decision forums across business and technology, driving alignment in a complex matrix without relying solely on formal authority.
• Use qualitative feedback, usage data and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities and continuously optimize the product.

Qualifications
Required
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Business or a related discipline. A master's degree is preferred.
• Typically 15+ years of relevant experience across software engineering, solution delivery or technology product management, including ownership of business-critical applications across their lifecycle.
• 15 year experience in MedTech, healthcare, preferably in Electro Physiology, preferably supporting pricing, contracting, tenders, commercial excellence or sales operations.
• Strong business knowledge of pricing governance, approval matrices, floor-price or margin controls, customer and product hierarchies, audit trails and downstream price execution.
• Experience with enterprise ERP commercial and supply chain data/processes, CRM, contracting, identity, data and analytics platforms, including JDE, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable technologies.
• Demonstrated experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Manager or product-focused technical leader, owning product vision, roadmaps, backlogs, releases, service performance and measurable outcomes.

• Strong technical application development experience with Microsoft-based application landscapes, including development in C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, APIs, integration patterns, GIT source control, automated testing and CI/CD.
• Experience modernizing legacy applications and managing technical debt, scalability, resilience, security, observability and supportability.
• Proven ability to translate complex commercial and pricing needs into clear product requirements and scalable technical solutions.
• Experience operating in agile and regulated environments with strong discipline in quality, cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, documentation and release governance.

The position manages and collaborates with business partners and stakeholders (Out Sourced Management Team, Clinical, PV, IT, Local Operating Companies, ESIQ, Call Centers, Brand Protection, External Manufacturing Sites, Internal/External Manufacturing Sites, QA, Business Quality, Medical Safety and R&D) to deliver effective change management, drive process improvements and identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency and timeliness of the complaint and MDR processes.

Position duties & responsibilities:
- Perform high-volume end-to-end complaint handling activities, including, but not limited to: Intake, triage and review of the event reported, determination of MDR reportability, recovery of field samples for evaluation, determination of Priority/Non-Priority, and QP notification to LOC. - Evaluate complaints to determine if the QTL’s or ULC’s have been exceeded, assess the level of investigation required, and assign to the applicable site for investigation.
- Governance and oversight for daily thru put of complaints and MDR decisions to ensure prioritization and KPI are met.
- Perform MDR evaluations and document written justification to support reportable and non-reportable regulatory decisions.
- Monitor complaints for new malfunction events that may require inclusion in the malfunction description list (MDL).
- Serve as a PQV point person for post market and complaint handling regulatory/MDR questions and inquiries; provides guidance and direction to subordinate Analyst roles and other PQV functions.
- Evaluate information from a technical perspective to ensure appropriate analysis and investigations/ MDR’s are accurately assessed for risk prioritization and performed per procedures, standards, and regulations.
- Back-up Product Quality Vigilance Investigation Support (PQVIS) personnel to support increased volume of complaints.
- Strong collaboration with Global Medical Safety, manufacturing sites, and LOC/BQ for effective complaint handling/MDR assessments and adverse events with potential product quality issues.
- Use technical and product knowledge to provide accurate feedback for escalation/awareness of issues and for current product enhancements/future product development, if applicable.
- Ensure that uniform and timely management of complaint records and regulatory reporting occurs per procedures, standards, and regulations.
- Compile and analyze data, metrics, and trends associated with the complaint handling processes.
- Support internal and external audits and inspections; ability to communicate regulatory and process positions as an SME during regulatory inspections and provide follow-up support as required.
- May interact with regulatory authorities, other J&J operating companies, and J&J global councils to interpret and influence emerging quality systems regulatory trends.
- Provide product workflow leadership to PQV peers to ensure consistent and fully understood End-to-End complaint management process.
- Oversee the PQC complaint monitoring process and analyze the outcome of complaint monitoring.
- For compliance risk events, coordinate and lead the root cause identification, ensuring effective corrective actions for mitigations are captured within QMS documentation (eg CAPA/QI).
- Coordinate and lead the process mapping and change for the development, revision, and/or maintenance of applicable department SOP’s, job aids, and WI’s.
- Works independently, challenges the status quo, identifies gaps, and drives process improvements using Process Excellence tools. Participates and/or leads special projects.
- Executes statistical/data-driven processes and documentation to support controlled risk management and decision making. Exhibits strong ability to collaborate and influence Business Partners to ensure appropriate complaint handling and improved complaint management processes.
- Leads remediation activities and generates the write up and execution of protocols documenting results and report approvals.
- Participates and/or leads special projects. Develop and deliver appropriate training (i.e. process, complaint handling, regulatory reporting) to complaint management system end users.
- Facilitate, lead and collaborate with PQV Reporting and Surveillance on New Product Introduction Processes.
- Interaction with IT partners and application vendors as required.

Professional experience requirements:
- 5+ years of related experience including Quality Assurance and/or Quality Control, including experience working in pharmaceutical and/or Medical Device or other related highly regulated industry
- Knowledge of medical safety environment and regulation
- Possesses strong organization skills supporting the ability to prioritize and manage workload and meet performance expectations.
- Strong knowledge of analytical, process mapping, investigation root cause and risk assessment tools
- Global mindset and demonstrated ability to lead change initiatives, project management and develop strong relationships
- Working knowledge of and experience with the following regulatory requirements: 21 CFR parts 4, 820, 803, 806, 210, 211, 314, ICH Q10, GDP, GMP, GVP, ISO 13485:2003, ISO 14971:2007/2012, MEDEV 2.12, CMDR and the Medical Device Directive 93/42/EEC

Educational requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree (preferred) in technical, scientific, or engineering disciplines required. Biomedical Engineer, Registered Nurse, Physician Assistant or similar healthcare provider/science license/certification/degree preferred.

Other requirements:
Location of Role: EMEA
Travel Requirements: This position may require up to 5-10% travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred Skills:
Business Alignment, Business Savvy, Coaching, Communication, Compliance Management, Continuous Improvement, Fact-Based Decision Making, Human-Centered Design, ISO 9001, Issue Escalation, Problem Solving, Quality Control (QC), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Quality Standards, Regulatory Environment, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
